title: Runtime A: Muse acts for Sam
lede: Real mode. Sam asks, PingOne signs him in and flags the agent, Sam consents, Muse gets a delegated token, and the gateway and Authorize let the tool run.

lanes.label: A. Muse in this demo, real mode: the agent acts for Sam

nodes.label: 2. Muse calls the gateway
sub: no token on purpose: 401 + where to sign in

nodes.label: 3. PingOne sign-in
sub: DaVinci: password, Protect, MFA on medium risk

nodes.label: 4. Agent detected
sub: Muse turns RED if Protect flagged it, BLUE if only the client id did

nodes.label: 6. Code back to Muse
sub: swapped for Sam's token, kept on the server

nodes.label: 7. Muse acts for Sam
sub: agent token + 2 token exchanges: sub = Sam, act = Muse

steps.title: Ask
steps.what: Sam asks Muse: "Show my airline points".

steps.title: 401, sign in
steps.what: Muse calls the gateway with no token, on purpose. The 401 says where to sign in.
steps.why: Nothing authenticated has been sent yet.

steps.title: Protect check
steps.what: PingOne runs the DaVinci flow: password, Protect risk, MFA on medium risk. Protect also checks whether the app is an agent.
steps.why: The agent is recognised by PingOne, not by its own word.

steps.title: Agent screen
steps.what: Sam sees "AI agent detected". The agent name is red if Protect flagged it, blue if only the client id did.
steps.why: Sam knows an agent is asking before he consents.

steps.title: Consent
steps.what: Sam allows Muse to act for him. PingOne returns a code to Muse.
steps.why: Consent is recorded before any token is issued.

steps.title: Code to token
steps.what: Muse swaps the code for Sam’s token. It stays on the Muse server.
steps.why: The browser never sees a token.

steps.title: Delegation
steps.what: Muse gets its own agent token, then makes two token exchanges. The result has sub = Sam and act = Muse.
steps.why: The gateway can tell who acts for whom.

steps.title: Authorize check
steps.what: Muse asks again with the delegated token. The gateway checks it, then asks PingOne Authorize: right audience, Muse a registered actor, tool allowed.

steps.title: Tool runs
steps.what: Allowed, so the tool runs and returns 4,500 points, Gold.
steps.why: The answer exists only because every check passed.
